google_001.name: Meghna Gupta
google_001.comment: Ayush is a wonderful yoga instructor who conducts his classes with positivity and dedication. His sessions are thoughtfully structured and tailored to make both beginners and advanced practitioners feel comfortable. I’ve gained tremendous benefits from his guidance — physically as well as mentally. I would highly recommend his group classes to anyone looking to improve strength, flexibility, and inner balance.

google_002.name: Neetha Simon
google_002.comment: I attend the yoga class led by Ayush. He is an excellent instructor. He always pushes us to cross our limits and is focused on the correct posture for each asana, explaining the muscles involved and the technique. My strength and flexibility has improved tremendously under his training.

google_003.name: Bhavna Sinha
google_003.comment: I've been a part of GroupFit's Zumba and Yoga classes and my instructors are absolutely fantastic. Their energy, enthusiasm, and expertise make every class a highlight. Ayush is hands down the best yoga instructor I have met. His teaching style is both challenging and nurturing.

google_004.name: Ritu Sharma
google_004.comment: Led by founder Ayush and a team of skilled trainers, GroupFit has been making fitness fun, effective, and affordable. The trainers are highly professional, supportive, and result-oriented, creating a positive and motivating community.

google_005.name: Pradeep Kumar Agarwal
google_005.comment: Ayush is a wonderful yoga teacher. He understands the needs of each person attending yoga and treats them with the right difficulty levels. His energy and smile are contagious.

google_006.name: Meenakshi Misra
google_006.comment: I have been doing yoga with Group Fit for a few years now. I highly recommend them if you are looking for a combination of yoga, power yoga, and strength training. All the trainers are excellent.
